subject: psychology

items.q: Which side of the body does the left hemisphere control?
items.why: Each hemisphere controls the opposite side of the body.

items.q: How do neurons pass signals to each other?
items.correct: Chemically, across a gap called the synapse.
items.misconception: By touching directly and passing electricity across.
items.why: An impulse is electrical along a neuron but crosses synapses using neurotransmitters.
